target: 100% completion of the selected Windows HD Remaster route, spoiler-free

areas.name: PC Route and Save Architecture
areas.location_cue: The Windows title screen, settings, save slots, inventory, partner commands, and map.
areas.note: Separate difficulty chains before earning file-bound rewards.

levels.1: Choose the edition that includes the remaster-only extra mode.
levels.2: Run Resident Evil Zero HD Remaster natively on Windows.
levels.3: Install the Windows HD Remaster and verify that Wesker Mode and the costume Suitcase are present in the menus or documented unlock flow. No console-exclusive campaign, mode, item, or costume requires a second platform.

items.label: Keep One Clear-Data Chain per Difficulty

levels.1: Bonus rewards attach to the difficulty of the completed file.
levels.2: Maintain separate Easy, Normal, and Hard clear-data slots.
levels.3: Start one save chain on each difficulty and never overwrite it with another setting. Load the file marked Clear to enter Leech Hunter or begin a rewarded replay; weapons and ammunition earned there remain tied to that chain.

levels.1: There are no storage boxes, but dropped objects remain mapped.
levels.2: Use the Training Facility main hall as the central drop point.
levels.3: Place spare weapons, ammunition, healing supplies, and long-term keys around the main-hall perimeter without stacking too many objects in one room. Check the map icons after every drop, and move the Hookshot forward whenever its next use approaches.

levels.1: Several mechanisms require separation and rapid switching.
levels.2: Practice Team, Solo, Attack, Idle, exchange, and character switching.
levels.3: In a cleared room, switch the lead character, order the partner to follow or wait, exchange a two-slot weapon, and move both independently. Keep the idle partner armed when separated because an off-screen grab can still empty their health.

save_backup.title: Back up the first save now
save_backup.why: Clear-data rewards and difficulty cannot be freely transferred.

areas.name: Campaign Difficulties, Ranks, and Outcome
areas.location_cue: The new-game difficulty selector and post-clear result screen.
areas.note: Complete every setting and preserve both timed rank bands.

levels.1: Each setting has its own supplies and reward-bearing save chain.
levels.2: Finish the campaign on Easy and save the Clear file.
levels.3: Select Easy for a fresh game, complete every physical region, and save the result into its own slot. Reload the Clear file once to verify its Extra Game options and keep later Leech Hunter rewards on that same difficulty.

levels.1: Each setting has its own supplies and reward-bearing save chain.
levels.2: Finish the campaign on Normal and save the Clear file.
levels.3: Select Normal for a fresh game, complete every physical region, and save the result into its own slot. Reload the Clear file once to verify its Extra Game options and keep later Leech Hunter rewards on that same difficulty.

levels.1: Each setting has its own supplies and reward-bearing save chain.
levels.2: Finish the campaign on Hard and save the Clear file.
levels.3: Select Hard for a fresh game, complete every physical region, and save the result into its own slot. Reload the Clear file once to verify its Extra Game options and keep later Leech Hunter rewards on that same difficulty.

levels.1: The highest result depends only on the completion clock.
levels.2: Finish Normal or Hard in less than three hours thirty minutes.
levels.3: Use an established Normal or Hard clear route, stage essential two-slot tools near their next doors, pause when planning, and cross the final gate before 3:30:00. Save the Clear result separately and verify both timed weapons are available.

levels.1: A second time band awards the automatic weapon separately.
levels.2: Finish Normal or Hard between three-thirty and five hours.
levels.3: Use Normal or Hard and finish after 3:30:00 but before 5:00:00, then preserve that result screen and Clear file. If Rank S already granted the same lower-tier reward, still record the A result as its own completion variant.

levels.1: This route has one mechanical completion outcome.
levels.2: Open the final four locks and finish the last arena.
levels.3: Carry both Shaft Keys into the final arena, operate the left and right controls with separate characters, then activate the four exposed locks in southwest, northwest, southeast, west order. Finish the remaining mechanical objective before the timer expires and save the Clear data.

save_backup.title: Keep rank attempts in fresh slots
save_backup.why: A slower completion can overwrite a useful rewarded Clear file.
